definitions.explanation: The largest amount of air a person can breathe out after breathing in as deeply as possible. Measured in school health checks and associated with singers, swimmers and wind players.

examples.japanese: {肺活量|はいかつりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
⟦{水泳|すいえい}{選手|せんしゅ}→水泳選手：29200_suieisenshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肺活量|はいかつりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
⟦{管楽器|かんがっき}→管楽器：07533_kangakki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{続|つづ}けて⟦いたら→いる：00495_iru⟧、{肺活量|はいかつりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧ずいぶん⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: After playing a wind instrument for a while, my lung capacity grew a lot.

notes:
⟦{肺|はい}→肺：12334_hai⟧ (lung) + {活|かつ} (activity) + ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (amount).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肺活量|はいかつりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ / ⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: to have large lung capacity
- {肺活量|はいかつりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧: to build up lung capacity
- {肺活量|はいかつりょう}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: a lung-capacity test

CULTURAL NOTE:
Measuring {肺活量|はいかつりょう} is part of the yearly physical examination ({身体測定|しんたいそくてい}) at many Japanese schools.
